New York Herald, 22 August 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Dublin, Eynon, Liverpool 4th, via
Queenstown 6th inst, with mdse and 407 passengers, to John
G Dale. Experienced strong westerly winds the dntire[?] pas-
sage. 5th inst, off Saltees, ship Ellen Austin, from Liver-
pool for New York; 9th, lat 51 26, lon 20 45, steamship Africa,
from Boston for Liverpool; same day, lat 49 40, lon 41 07,
steamship Scotie, hence for do; same day, bark Geronia,
bound W.
